title: Dialog 실전 문제

questions.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 빈칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르거나, 빈칸이면 그 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ② Yes, I've heard about it. Have you heard ~?에는 들어 본 적이 있는지 Yes, I've ~ 또는 No, I haven't ~로 답한다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 실전 01)
questions.promptEn:
Choose the best response.

A: Have you heard about the new library?
B: ______
choices: I couldn't go there yesterday.
Yes, I've heard about it.
Did you enjoy it?
Yes, it will be there soon.
No, I don't know how to read.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ④ I'm glad that you won the game. ①②③⑤는 놀람이고 ④는 기쁨이다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 실전 02)
questions.promptEn: Which sentence does NOT express surprise?
choices: I'm surprised to see this place so crowded.
I'm shocked that the test was so easy.
Really? That's surprising!
I'm glad that you won the game.
I can't believe that you finished the project so fast.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ I am familiar with this English book. 새 영어 선생님에 대해 들어 봤는지 묻는 말에 영어 책을 잘 안다는 답은 어색하다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 실전 03)
questions.promptEn:
Which response does NOT fit?

A: Have you heard about the new English teacher?
B: ______
choices: Really? I have no idea.
Yes, I heard he is very kind.
I am familiar with this English book.
No, not yet. What does he look like?
No, I haven't. Tell me more about him in detail.

questions.ruleKo: hear, have, self-driving을 넣어 여섯 단어로 쓰세요.
questions.sectionInstructionKo: 여섯 단어의 문장으로 쓰시오. hear, have, self-driving을 넣어 여섯 단어로 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: Have you heard about self-driving bikes? 무언가에 대해 들어 본 적이 있는지 물을 때 Have you heard ~?를 쓴다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 실전 04)
questions.promptEn:
[04-07] Read the dialog and answer.

B: There are so many things to see at this show!
G: You're right. What would you like to see first?
B: (a) ______? I'd like to see them first!
G: Oh, I'm surprised that a bike can drive itself!
(b) ______
B: They have cameras and sensors. So, they can check the area around them, and they can choose the best way.
G: They sound similar to self-driving cars. What else can they do?
B: (c) 그것들은 스스로 멈출 수 있어, if there is something in the way.
G: Wow, that's interesting.

04 Write blank (a) as a sentence of six words. Use hear, have, and self-driving.
accept: Have you heard about self-driving bikes?

questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ What / How. (a)는 What is the drone for?이고 (b)는 How does it do that?이다. (답지 p.38 Dialog 실전 08)
questions.promptEn:
[08-09] Read the dialog and answer.

B: Look at that drone! The man over there is flying it.
G: Yes, I see that. (a) ______ is the drone for?
B: It helps farmers. It makes their work easier.
G: Really? (b) ______ does it do that?
B: It can plant seeds. Then it can fly over the fields and water them.
G: Wow. (c) I'm surprised that a drone can do all that.

08 Choose the correct pair for (a) and (b).
choices: What / When
How / When
What / How
How / Where
Where / How

B: Juhee, have you heard about smart refrigerators?

G: I'm surprised that a refrigerator can do that. I want to have one at my house.
B: Me too. It would make cooking (b) ______.
